name: lrc-sidecar
description: Safely find synchronized lyrics and write LRC sidecars for a local music library

scripts.test:installer: bash -n scripts/install.sh && bash scripts/install.sh --help | grep -q -- '--service-user NAME'
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --include='dist/src/**/*.js' --exclude='dist/src/cli.js' --check-coverage --lines=80 --branches=80 --functions=80 --statements=80 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov node --test dist/test/**/*.test.js
